newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak SAX index edges up in listless activity.
newsitem.headline: Slovak SAX index edges up in listless activity.

text.p: Major Slovak shares were little changed in listless trading on the Bratislava Stock Exchange (BSE) on Thursday, with SAX index edging slightly higher on gains to the average prices of several blue chips.
The official 16-share SAX index was boosted by average price in oil refinery Slovnaft, which increased by 1.3 percent, while the issue traded 59 shares and closed unchanged at 1,040 crowns.
Brokers said the bourse has been stagnating due to political and economic instability and uncertainty on the country's money market.
Some brokers added major share prices might ease to more attractive levels in the near future, which could lure back investors.
Overall volume decreased to 93,210 shares, from 171,313 shares traded on Wednesday, while turnover fell to 31.61 million crowns, from 45.36 million.
